about: The user guide's screenshots, captured from the web UI with demo data (internal/screenshot) by scripts/capture-docs-screenshots.sh into docs/user-guide/images/<id>.png. A guide image names its screen. path and query open it in screenshot mode; readyText is on the page once it has loaded; actions (click, fill, wait) reach the state the page describes. viewport, deviceScaleFactor, theme (dark or light), and form (phone or tablet) can be set per screen.

screens.readyText: Notify when the price is below $500
